dedupe_keys.name: greater noumea located buildings reference refil gie serail

description: GIE SERAIL (Greater Nouméa) publishes a point location base of named buildings and building complexes in greater Nouméa, built from the sources of the members of the SERAIL economic interest group, with name, identifier, type, two address references, neighbourhood, coordinates, owner, manager and delivery date. Coverage: the greater Nouméa area, New Caledonia; about 3,900 points, record last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of New Caledonia (data.gouv.nc). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: the data remain the exclusive property of GIE SERAIL and are shared under the Etalab open licence 2.0 together with general conditions of use that require crediting the source and the group logo. Simulation uses: building locations for exposure and emergency-response analyses of the Nouméa urban area, and for geocoding named sites. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Greater Nouméa: Located Buildings Reference (REFIL, GIE SERAIL)
